definition.name: 完播率
definition.definition: 播放开始中有完成事件的播放次数比例。
definition.numerator: content_events 中有 complete 的去重 play_id 数
definition.denominator: 有 start 的去重 play_id 数；为零则不可计算
definition.joins: content_events.session_id = sessions.session_id；sessions.user_id = users.user_id；start/complete 按 play_id 关联
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai；播放开始日在 [start,end)；content_events/sessions 水位完整；不能把缺失当零
definition.pitfalls: 重复上报去重；重复观看新 play_id；完成事件缺失影响观测，独立 playback_telemetry 可交叉核对，不能仅凭差异证明采集故障

parameters.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT play_id, MIN(session_id) AS sid, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS began,
      MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS start_times,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
      SUM(CASE WHEN session_id IS NULL OR play_id IS NULL OR occurred_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
      FROM content_events GROUP BY play_id)
      SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,s.os AS actual_os,s.version AS actual_version,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starts,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NOT NULL THEN e.completed ELSE 0 END) AS observed_completed,
      SUM(CASE WHEN e.began IS NULL OR e.sessions<>1 OR e.invalid>0 OR e.start_times<>1 OR e.first_event<e.began OR s.session_id IS NULL OR s.started_at>e.began THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_alignment
      FROM e LEFT JOIN sessions s ON e.sid=s.session_id WHERE CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01' AND CAST(COALESCE(e.began,e.first_event) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15'
      GROUP BY period,s.os,s.version ORDER BY period,s.os,s.version

parameters.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT play_id,MIN(session_id) AS sid,COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS began,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM content_events GROUP BY play_id),
      t AS (SELECT play_id,MIN(session_id) AS sid,COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
        MIN(observed_at) AS observed, MAX(watched_seconds) AS watched,
        MIN(duration_seconds) AS duration,MAX(duration_seconds) AS max_duration,
        SUM(CASE WHEN session_id IS NULL OR play_id IS NULL OR observed_at IS NULL OR watched_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds IS NULL OR watched_seconds<0 OR duration_seconds<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
        FROM playback_telemetry GROUP BY play_id),
      p AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,s.os AS actual_os,s.version AS actual_version,
        e.completed,t.duration,
        CASE WHEN e.sessions=1 AND s.started_at<=e.began AND t.sid=e.sid AND t.sessions=1 AND t.invalid=0 AND t.duration=t.max_duration AND t.observed>=e.began AND t.watched<=t.duration THEN t.watched END AS valid_watched,
        CASE WHEN e.began IS NULL OR t.sid<>e.sid OR t.sessions<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unaligned,
        CASE WHEN t.play_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unmatched,
        CASE WHEN t.invalid>0 OR t.duration<>t.max_duration OR t.observed<e.began OR t.watched>t.duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
        FROM e FULL JOIN t ON e.play_id=t.play_id LEFT JOIN sessions s ON e.sid=s.session_id WHERE CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01' AND CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
      SELECT period,actual_os,actual_version,COUNT(*) AS instances,
        SUM(unaligned) AS invalid_alignment,SUM(unmatched) AS unmatched,SUM(invalid) AS invalid_telemetry,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS independent_complete,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=duration AND completed=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_completion,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=CASE WHEN duration<5 THEN duration ELSE 5 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective
      FROM p GROUP BY period,actual_os,actual_version

definition.denominator: 有 start 的去重 play_id 数；为零则不可计算
definition.joins: content_events.session_id = sessions.session_id；sessions.user_id = users.user_id；start/complete 按 play_id 关联
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai；播放开始日在 [start,end)；content_events/sessions 水位完整；不能把缺失当零
definition.pitfalls: 重复上报去重；重复观看新 play_id；完成事件缺失影响观测，独立 playback_telemetry 可交叉核对，不能仅凭差异证明采集故障

candidates.explanation: 两条采集链路齐备且实例可对齐，独立观看进度达到完整时长但缺完成事件，支持完成事件采集缺失候选。

unexcluded_factors: 无法仅凭观测完播率下降认定用户行为恶化；两链路同步偏差及独立遥测本身错误未排除。
statistical_limitations: 播放实例不是独立用户样本；仅发布描述性比例，不做用户级独立二项检验或置信区间。
候选解释需要人工复核，不证明故障因果。

definition.name: 完播率
definition.definition: 播放开始中有完成事件的播放次数比例。
definition.numerator: content_events 中有 complete 的去重 play_id 数
definition.denominator: 有 start 的去重 play_id 数；为零则不可计算
definition.joins: content_events.session_id = sessions.session_id；sessions.user_id = users.user_id；start/complete 按 play_id 关联
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai；播放开始日在 [start,end)；content_events/sessions 水位完整；不能把缺失当零
definition.pitfalls: 重复上报去重；重复观看新 play_id；完成事件缺失影响观测，独立 playback_telemetry 可交叉核对，不能仅凭差异证明采集故障

sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT play_id,MIN(session_id) AS sid,COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_type='start' THEN occurred_at END) AS began,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_type='complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed FROM content_events GROUP BY play_id),
      t AS (SELECT play_id,MIN(session_id) AS sid,COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
        MIN(observed_at) AS observed, MAX(watched_seconds) AS watched,
        MIN(duration_seconds) AS duration,MAX(duration_seconds) AS max_duration,
        SUM(CASE WHEN session_id IS NULL OR play_id IS NULL OR observed_at IS NULL OR watched_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds IS NULL OR watched_seconds<0 OR duration_seconds<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
        FROM playback_telemetry GROUP BY play_id),
      p AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-08' THEN 'previous' ELSE 'current' END AS period,s.os AS actual_os,s.version AS actual_version,
        e.completed,t.duration,
        CASE WHEN e.sessions=1 AND s.started_at<=e.began AND t.sid=e.sid AND t.sessions=1 AND t.invalid=0 AND t.duration=t.max_duration AND t.observed>=e.began AND t.watched<=t.duration THEN t.watched END AS valid_watched,
        CASE WHEN e.began IS NULL OR t.sid<>e.sid OR t.sessions<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unaligned,
        CASE WHEN t.play_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unmatched,
        CASE WHEN t.invalid>0 OR t.duration<>t.max_duration OR t.observed<e.began OR t.watched>t.duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
        FROM e FULL JOIN t ON e.play_id=t.play_id LEFT JOIN sessions s ON e.sid=s.session_id WHERE CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)>='2026-01-01' AND CAST(COALESCE(e.began,t.observed) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE)<'2026-01-15')
      SELECT period,actual_os,actual_version,COUNT(*) AS instances,
        SUM(unaligned) AS invalid_alignment,SUM(unmatched) AS unmatched,SUM(invalid) AS invalid_telemetry,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS independent_complete,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=duration AND completed=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_completion,
        SUM(CASE WHEN valid_watched>=CASE WHEN duration<5 THEN duration ELSE 5 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective
      FROM p GROUP BY period,actual_os,actual_version
